description: Common-cathode RGB LED D1 driven by three logic inputs: J_IN_R, J_IN_G and J_IN_B each feed one colour anode through its own 220 Ohm resistor, and the common cathode goes to the shared ground.
assumptions: Each logic input is a hand-wired power_connector_2pin (positive = logic signal, negative = ground); the three grounds and the common cathode share GND.
Logic level not given; at 5 V logic each channel draws about (5 - 2) V / 220 Ohm = 14 mA (less at 3.3 V). Check the driver's per-pin current limit.
Default _gap_0 variants for the resistors and the RGB LED (leads in adjacent holes); RGB pin order red, green, blue, common cathode as in the kit.
